definitions: An organized collection of immune cells that forms in non-lymphoid tissues at sites of chronic inflammation or infection.
Ectopic lymphoid aggregates that resemble secondary lymphoid organs and contribute to local immune responses.
examples: The presence of a tertiary lymphoid structure often indicates ongoing immune activity.
Researchers are studying the role of tertiary lymphoid structure formation in autoimmune diseases.
A tertiary lymphoid structure can be a site of antigen presentation and lymphocyte activation.
